name: Editor's Choice outreach

rules: Due follow-ups always take the daily 30 slots before any new first-touch.
Existing threads whose last email was more than 2 days ago are due today (one catch-up email). Being overdue does not skip them and does not dump the rest of the sequence the same day.
After that send, the next step in the same thread waits 2 days.
Replied / Positive / Won / Rejected / No Response never enter the queue.

schedule.drafts: Weekdays 20:00 America/New_York: create next day's personalized Gmail drafts
schedule.review: Claire verifies every draft the same night
schedule.send: Weekdays 09:00 America/New_York: send only drafts that still exist (edited drafts send as edited; deleted drafts are skipped)

exitWhen: status is Replied, Positive, Won / Published, Rejected, or No Response

classifier.asked_backlink: First email asked to include the recognition on a Press/Awards page and/or offered badge, logo files, and copy.
classifier.no_backlink: First email only asked to fact-check rooms/amenities or send photos. No placement ask.
classifier.new_contact: No 1st Contact yet. Uses the four-email sequence that withholds the backlink ask until email 3.

rules: Never send or queue a draft that still contains a bracket placeholder.
first_name is the Primary Contact first name. If unknown, use '{{hotel_name}} team' (or the hotel-team greeting already in that template).
hht_listing_url must be the live Hotel Hot Tubs listing for that hotel, never a homepage or OTA link.

property_blurb is 1-2 sentences about THIS property, written from the listing (room types, tub type, setting). It must name something specific (a suite, a tub style, oceanfront/courtyard/etc). Do not reuse another hotel's blurb. Do not use the oceanfront example from the spec. If you cannot write a specific blurb from real listing facts, skip the lead. Do not send a generic compliment.
fact_to_verify is one concrete listing question to confirm (a room type, tub location, or amenity). Pull it from the live listing. Write it as a complete question. Do not invent it.
Do not invent room names, amenities, or photos.
Do not use em dashes in sent copy. Prefer a period, comma, or a new sentence.
Pick the sequence from the first-touch body, not from the scraped CSV recipient. Asked-backlink vs fact-check is about what Claire already sent.

editors-choice.audience: Hotels we have not emailed yet (no 1st Contact). Initial email does not ask for a backlink.

steps.name: Recognition + listing check
steps.subject: {{hotel_name}} selected for Hotel Hot Tubs Editor's Choice 2026
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

I'm Claire, communications manager at Hotel Hot Tubs. We selected {{hotel_name}} for our 2026 Editor's Choice, one of about 200 properties selected from 6,000+ U.S. stays.

Here's the hotel feature:
{{hht_listing_url}}

And the full Editor's Choice collection:
https://hotelhottubs.com/editors-choice

{{property_blurb}}

{{fact_to_verify}} If anything else has changed, I'd be glad to update that too.

If you have preferred photos of the rooms, tubs, or property, feel free to send them over and we'll use the best current imagery.

Thanks,
Claire

steps.name: Make the reply easy
steps.subject: Quick check on the {{hotel_name}} feature
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Just following up on the {{hotel_name}} feature. We're doing a final accuracy pass and I wanted to make sure we have the tub details right.

{{fact_to_verify}}

A quick reply is perfect. If someone else at the property would know, feel free to point me their way.

Feature:
{{hht_listing_url}}

Thanks,
Claire

steps.name: Introduce the Editor's Choice assets
steps.subject: Editor's Choice assets for {{hotel_name}}
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

One other thing I wanted to send your way. We have Editor's Choice 2026 badge and logo assets available for the hotels we selected.

If those would be useful for your marketing or PR team, I'm happy to send them along with a short piece of copy explaining the recognition.

We're also still happy to update the feature with any preferred photography or corrected property details.

Best,
Claire

steps.name: Soft awards / press page ask
steps.subject: Re: {{hotel_name}} selected for Editor's Choice 2026
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Last note from me on this. We're glad to have {{hotel_name}} included in this year's Editor's Choice collection.

If the hotel maintains a Press, Awards, News, or Accolades page, we'd love for the recognition to be included there with a link to the feature:
{{hht_listing_url}}

I can send the badge, logo files, and ready-to-use copy if that makes it easier. If someone else handles PR or website updates, I'm happy to connect with them directly.

Thanks,
Claire
